# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 4 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Against the Hypocrite in the Council

---

**4:1** Why do you sit in the assembly of the devout, O defiler,
you whose heart is far from the LORD?

**4:2** You provoke by your transgressions the God of Israel,
excelling in lawless deeds among the wicked.

**4:3** Presumptuous in speech, presumptuous in appearance —
yet harsh in his words when reproving sinners.

**4:4** His hand is the first to be raised against him as if in zeal,
yet he himself is guilty of many disgraceful sins.

**4:5** His eyes are on every woman without discretion;
his tongue lies when he swears a covenant.

**4:6** By night and in secret he transgresses;
he is a thief, yet his outward appearance is fair.

**4:7** His eyes range over every woman;
his tongue lies when he makes a solemn pledge.

**4:8** May God remove those who live in hypocrisy from among the devout,
those who spend their life in the flesh of a stranger.

**4:9** May God destroy those who live in hypocrisy with corruption,
for their life has been spent in dishonesty.

**4:10** O God, expose their deeds to mockery before all Israel;
expose them as they have exposed others.

**4:11** Let their portion be poverty and want;
let their inheritance be left empty.

**4:12** Let their old age be spent in childlessness;
let them die in desolation.

**4:13** May the bones of the slanderers be scattered far from those who fear the LORD;
let there be no rest for them in their resting place.

**4:14** For with his tongue he seduces honorable men
and with lawless words misleads the souls of the innocent.

**4:15** He cuts short the life of young men;
he destroys the beauty of young women.

**4:16** He causes the noble to stumble in secret ways
before the eyes of all.

**4:17** Let him be homeless and wandering;
let no one dwell in his house.

**4:18** Let his days on earth be few;
let his old age come in shame and poverty.

**4:19** May the LORD smite those who sit on councils of power
and lord it over the innocent among the devout.

**4:20** May God destroy their dwelling place in desolation;
may he cut off their offspring from the earth.

**4:21** For with deceit they beguiled the souls of the righteous
and led astray the house of Israel.

**4:22** Therefore, O Lord, render them their due;
hand them over to the power of the righteous.

**4:23** Deliver me, O God, from the sinner
who plots evil against me.

**4:24** Keep the evil one far from me, O LORD;
let his face be put to shame before me.

**4:25** Direct my steps in your truth, O LORD;
let not the sins of the wicked prevail against me.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Preferred readings noted where agents diverge.*
